summary.value: Action + 10 MP: choose dazed, shaken, slow or weak.

system.description: Action + 10 MP: choose dazed, shaken, slow or weak. At the start of each of your later turns this conflict, every enemy suffering it takes (SL × 3) damage — no Check, no roll; the type matches an equipped weapon, else physical. One status at a time; an action switches it.
